source_row.rationale: In the context of suspected infectious diarrhea with concerning features such as fever or bloody stools (which may suggest certain bacterial pathogens), antimotility agents like loperamide are generally used with caution, since slowing intestinal transit could potentially worsen the illness or delay clearance of the pathogen/toxin in some cases, warranting provider consultation before use in this scenario.
source_row.source_detail: Caution with Antimotility Agents in Certain Infectious Diarrhea
